message:
Hi, my name is John Romney, Senior Vice President at Franchise Creator.
We work with established brands to expand strategically through franchising, and after reviewing your company online, I believe your concept may be well-positioned for franchise expansion.
I’d welcome the opportunity to connect directly to explore whether franchising could be a viable expansion path for your business.
If easier, you can share this message directly or use my calendar link below to schedule a brief introductory call:
https://calendly.com/fc-franchise-development/cf-franchise-development
